description: Read an existing identity/VAT verification created by verify_supplier_payment (POST /v1/verifications). Supply its returned verification_id UUID, not a request_id, transaction_id, invoice number or A2A task ID. Returns the stored RELEASE/REVIEW/BLOCK/INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE result without rerunning registry checks. The same authenticated tenant must own the result: use the original paying wallet for x402, or an authorized bearer token with verification.read scope. Missing or other-tenant IDs return not found. This does not retrieve decide_supplier_payment decisions and does not create a verification. Retrieval has its own service fee; inspect terms and obtain spending approval before paying. Do not retry payment automatically or infer invoice-payment authorization from a stored advisory result.

verification_id.description: UUID returned as verification_id by verify_supplier_payment or POST /v1/verifications. Use a result owned by the same tenant/original paying wallet; do not supply request_id, transaction_id, an invoice number or an A2A task ID.
verification_id.title: Verification Id
